table.description:
// Used in cylinder cut calculation // "42/255 is the amount of torque reduction per cylinder from a hard cut" (0xff - torque_limit_base_factor) * (6 - torque_cut_level_as_cyl_count)
What It Represents
This is the base torque capacity/efficiency factor at each RPM×load operating point. It's used to:
1. Compare against external torque requests - torque_limit_external_factor (from TC, ABS, stability control) 2. Calculate cylinder cuts needed - when external request is below base factor, determines how many cylinders to cut 3. Define engine torque envelope - maps where the engine can produce full torque vs. derated
